description: Land Title Settlement Department - Puttalam, Puttalam D/S Division, Puttalam District - Cad. Map No. 410111
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains a declaration by the Commissioner of Title Settlement determining ownership of specific land parcels in Puttalam, along with a detailed schedule listing parcel numbers, owners' details, extent of land, title classifications, and any encumbrances. The content focuses entirely on land property matters without any government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories.
